## Load Packages
```{r, message=FALSE}
#| code-fold: true
library(DT)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(ggimage)
library(showtext)
library(tidyverse)

# load google font
font_add_google(name = "Saira", family = "Saira")

# turn on showtext
showtext_auto()
```

## Connect to Database
```{r}
kanto_database <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "kanto_database.duckdb")
```

```{r}
# list all tables from database
dbListTables(kanto_database)
```

## Query Database

### Q1. What is the distribution of Kanto Pokémon by growth rate, and which ones grow the fastest?
```{r}
# query the number of pokémon for each assigned growth rate
q1.1_query <- dbGetQuery(kanto_database,
                         "SELECT growth_rate, COUNT(*) AS total
                         FROM training_breeding_stats
                         LEFT JOIN growth_rate
                            ON training_breeding_stats.growth_rate_id = growth_rate.growth_rate_id
                         GROUP BY growth_rate
                         ORDER BY total DESC;")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| code-fold: true
# poké ball palette
palette <- c("#bc1c0c", "#ee4035", "#ffffff", "#a09f9d")

# donut plot (poké ball)
p1 <- q1.1_query %>%
  mutate(percent = total/sum(total),
         ymax = cumsum(percent),
         ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n = -1)),
         position = (ymax + ymin)/2,
         label = total) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 2.5, xmax = 4, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,  fill = growth_rate), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", start = -pi/2) +
  xlim(c(2, 4)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 3.3, y = position, label = label), size = 5, color = "black", family = "Saira") +
  geom_text(x = 2, y = 2, label = 151, size = 5, family = "Saira") +
  geom_point(aes(x = 2, y = 1), shape = 21, size = 15, stroke = 1.5, color = "black", fill = NA) +
  labs(title = "Pokémon Growth Rates in the Kanto Region",
       subtitle = "Distribution of common growth rate types in Generation I",
       fill = "Growth Rate") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.text.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.width = unit(3.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, family = "Saira"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Saira"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", family = "Saira"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, family = "Saira"),
        plot.margin = margin(b = 5, t = 5, unit = "mm"))

# display plot
p1
```

```{r}
# query only pokémon with a fast growth rate in descending order by total base stats
q1.2_query <- dbGetQuery(kanto_database,
                         "SELECT training_breeding_stats.national_no, training_breeding_stats.pokemon,
                                 type_1, hp, attack, defense, sp_atk, sp_def, speed, total
                         FROM training_breeding_stats
                         LEFT JOIN growth_rate
                            ON training_breeding_stats.growth_rate_id = growth_rate.growth_rate_id
                         LEFT JOIN base_stats
                            ON training_breeding_stats.national_no = base_stats.national_no
                         WHERE growth_rate.growth_rate LIKE '%Fast%'
                         ORDER BY total DESC;")
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
# fast growth rate data table
q1.2_query %>%
  datatable(colnames = c("National No.", "Pokémon", "Type",
                         "HP", "Attack", "Defense", "Sp. Atk",
                         "Sp. Def", "Speed", "Total"),
            class = "row-border",
            caption = "Pokémon with Fast Growth Rates Ranked by Total Base Stats",
            options = list(dom = "t", 
                           ordering = FALSE,
                           columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"))))
```

### Q2. How are Kanto region Pokémon distributed across egg groups, and what trends emerge between their primary and secondary groups?
```{r}
# query the number of pokémon for each egg group (primary and secondary)
q2_query <- dbGetQuery(kanto_database,
                       "SELECT egg_group_id, egg_group,
                       COALESCE(primary_total, 0) AS primary_total,
                       COALESCE(secondary_total, 0) AS secondary_total
                       FROM egg_groups
                       LEFT JOIN (SELECT egg_group_1, count(*) AS primary_total
                                  FROM egg_info
                                  GROUP BY egg_group_1) AS table_1
                          ON egg_groups.egg_group_id = table_1.egg_group_1
                       LEFT JOIN (SELECT egg_group_2, count(*) AS secondary_total
                                  FROM egg_info
                                  GROUP BY egg_group_2) AS table_2
                          ON egg_groups.egg_group_id = table_2.egg_group_2
                       ORDER BY egg_group_id ASC;")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| code-fold: true
# great ball image file path
great_ball <- "images/assets/great_ball.png"

# ultra ball image file path
ultra_ball <- "images/assets/ultra_ball.png"

# dumbbell plot
p2 <- q2_query %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_segment(x = 0.4, xend = 0.4, y = 0, yend = 26, color = "grey", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_segment(x = 0.4, xend = 15.5, y = 0, yend = 0, color = "grey", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = reorder(egg_group, primary_total), xend = egg_group, y = primary_total, yend = secondary_total)) +
  geom_image(aes(x = egg_group, y = primary_total, image = ultra_ball), size = 0.06) +
  geom_image(aes(x = egg_group, y = secondary_total, image = great_ball), size = 0.06) +
  annotate(geom = "rect", xmin = 6, xmax = 10, ymin  = 20, ymax = 25, fill = NA, linewidth = 1, color = "grey") +
  geom_text(aes(x = 9, y = 22.5, label = "Egg Groups"), size = 4, family = "Saira", hjust = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 8, y = 21.8, label = "Group 1"), size = 4, family = "Saira", hjust = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 7, y = 21.8, label = "Group 2"), size = 4, family = "Saira", hjust = 0) +
  geom_image(aes(x = 8, y = 21, image = ultra_ball), size = 0.06) +
  geom_image(aes(x = 7, y = 21, image = great_ball), size = 0.06) +
  labs(y = "Number of Pokémon",
       title = "Egg Group Distribution of Kanto Pokémon",
       subtitle = "Comparing Primary and Secondary Groups") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "black", family = "Saira", margin = margin(r = 5, unit = "mm")),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 1, color = "grey"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "Saira", margin = margin(t = 2, unit = "mm")),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "Saira", margin = margin(t = 2, unit = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", family = "Saira"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, family = "Saira"),
        plot.margin = margin(l = 5, r = 12, b = 5, t = 5, unit = "mm"))

# display plot
p2
```
